# Flotech Heating and Plumbing

> Gas Safe registered heating and plumbing engineers based in Little Canfield, near Great Dunmow, Essex. Boiler installation (Ideal and Vaillant accredited), boiler servicing and repairs, power flushing and unvented cylinders for homes across Bishop's Stortford, Hertfordshire and Essex.

- Company: Flotech Heating & Plumbing Ltd, registered in England and Wales, company number 08739272
- Registered office: 62 Burgattes Road, Little Canfield, Dunmow, Essex, CM6 1FW
- Phone: 01279 598 972
- Email: office@flotechheating.co.uk
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:30 to 17:30
- Areas: Bishop's Stortford, Sawbridgeworth, Great Dunmow, Takeley, Stansted, Saffron Walden, Harlow, Chelmsford, Cambridge, Hertfordshire and Essex
- Boiler installation finance is available through Phoenix Financial Consultants Ltd (Flotech is an Introducer Appointed Representative of Phoenix)
